text: We are a manufacturer in Perth looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

## 💡 Key Things to Discuss With Any of These Consultants

When you reach out, make sure to cover:

| Topic | Why It Matters |
|---|---|
| **ERP connector/API availability** | They need to assess how Power Automate can integrate with your specific ERP (e.g., SAP, MYOB Acuity, Pronto, Epicor, etc.) |
| **Shop-floor data capture** | Power Apps canvas apps can run on tablets/mobile devices on the factory floor — offline-capable |
| **Order processing automation** | Power Automate can trigger workflows from ERP events, emails, or forms |
| **Power BI reporting** | Real-time dashboards pulling data from your ERP without replacing it |
| **Dataverse vs. ERP as system of record** | Important architectural decision for data integrity |

---

**My recommendation:** Start with **Ultron Developments** (Perth-based, manufacturing-aware, ERP integration experience) and **Power Platform Experts Perth** (long track record, local team). Both can assess your ERP's integration capabilities before committing to a solution design.
